subject: LAB-017
check: Conflict, retained tombstone, account isolation, cancellation, authorization and duplicate qualification
steps: Use fresh temporary directories and in-memory OperationService backends, FileSyncProfile or DisabledSyncProfile; remove test directories on cleanup

outcome.detail: 17 tests in 5 suites passed. Both offline edits stay inspectable until a choice; stale choice leaves document bytes unchanged. Deleting the same synthetic device directory and recreating it pulls a retained tombstone; importing the older document twice still leaves two envelopes and deleted state. Account B receives no private Account A record; foreign document/directory and nonmember share access are refused. Disabled profile has zero pulls/pushes. Unauthorized deletion and model commits are refused; cancelled commit/import writes nothing and import retry succeeds once. Crash replay and duplicate import preserve one operation/record.

limitations: Local file-profile and manual-document fixtures on macOS 27.0 (26A425); not CloudKit, Apple account switching, OS reinstall, or a physical device run.
No network, account connection, screenshot, recording or real user data.
Package tests do not establish the host reopening its in-memory materialization; that is checked separately.
